newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND DEFENDER SOUTHGATE OUT FOR A MONTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND DEFENDER SOUTHGATE OUT FOR A MONTH.

text.p: England defender Gareth Southgate could be sidelined until the New Year with an ankle injury he suffered in Aston Villa's League Cup defeat at Wimbledon on Tuesday.

Villa assistant manager Alan Evans said onWednesday Southgate would be out of action for at least four weeks after another setback to the ankle he initially damaged on World Cup duty against Poland at Wembley in October.
He is to have a precautionary x-ray within the next 24 hours to assess whether there is any bone damage.
"He has hurt both the inside and the outside of the ankle and will be out of action for a minimum of four weeks. For him to come back any time before that would be a massive bonus," Evans said.

The only consolation for Southgate is that the injury is unlikely to affect him from an England point of view as Glenn Hoddle's side are not again in action until a World Cup qualifier with Italy at Wembley in February.
